question_text.english:
Consider the situation shown in figure. The force F is equal to \(\frac{m_2 g}{2}\). If the area of cross section of the wire is A and its Young's modulus is Y, then the strain developed in the wire is -
(wire is light and there is no friction anywhere)
question_text.hindi:
चित्र में प्रदर्शित परिस्थिति पर विचार करें। बल F, \(\frac{m_2 g}{2}\) के बराबर है। यदि तार का अनुप्रस्थ काट क्षेत्रफल A तथा इसका यंग गुणांक Y है, तब तार में उत्पन्न विकृति है -
(तार हल्का है तथा कहीं भी कोई घर्षण नहीं है)

visuals.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 250 120'><rect x='20' y='50' width='60' height='30' fill='#f0f0f0' stroke='black'/><text x='50' y='70' text-anchor='middle' font-size='12'>m₁</text><line x1='80' y1='65' x2='150' y2='65' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='150' cy='65' r='10' fill='white' stroke='black'/><line x1='150' y1='75' x2='150' y2='100' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='135' y='100' width='30' height='30' fill='#f0f0f0' stroke='black'/><text x='150' y='120' text-anchor='middle' font-size='12'>m₂</text><line x1='5' y1='65' x2='20' y2='65' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><polygon points='5,60 5,70 0,65' fill='black'/><text x='12' y='55' text-anchor='middle' font-size='12'>F</text></svg>
visuals.description: A block m1 connected via a light inextensible string over a frictionless pulley to a hanging block m2, with a force F pulling m1 to the left.

answer.method: Calculate acceleration of the system, tension in the string, stress, and then strain = stress / Y.

explanation.english: Acceleration of the system a = \(\frac{m_2 g - F}{m_1 + m_2} = \frac{m_2 g - m_2 g / 2}{m_1 + m_2} = \frac{m_2 g}{2(m_1 + m_2)}\). Tension T in the horizontal wire: \(T - F = m_1 a \implies T = F + m_1 a = \frac{m_2 g}{2} + m_1 \frac{m_2 g}{2(m_1 + m_2)} = \frac{m_2 g (2m_1 + m_2)}{2(m_1 + m_2)}\). Stress = T / A. Strain = Stress / Y = \(\frac{m_2 g (2m_1 + m_2)}{2AY(m_1 + m_2)}\).
explanation.hindi: निकाय का त्वरण a = \(\frac{m_2 g - F}{m_1 + m_2} = \frac{m_2 g - m_2 g / 2}{m_1 + m_2} = \frac{m_2 g}{2(m_1 + m_2)}\)। क्षैतिज तार में तनाव T: \(T - F = m_1 a \implies T = F + m_1 a = \frac{m_2 g (2m_1 + m_2)}{2(m_1 + m_2)}\)। प्रतिबल = T / A। विकृति = प्रतिबल / Y = \(\frac{m_2 g (2m_1 + m_2)}{2AY(m_1 + m_2)}\)।
steps: Find acceleration of system using Newton's second law.
Find tension in the wire attached to mass m1.
Calculate strain as stress divided by Young's modulus Y.

explanation.english: Matches the derived formula for strain.
explanation.hindi: विकृति के व्युत्पन्न सूत्र से मेल खाता है।
कोष्ठक के अंदर गलत द्रव्यमान पद।

question_text.english: A block of mass 1kg is at rest on a rough horizontal surface having coefficient of static friction 0.2 and kinetic friction 0.15. Find the frictional force if a horizontal force F = 1 N is applied on the block -
question_text.hindi: एक किलोग्राम द्रव्यमान का एक ब्लॉक एक खुरदरे क्षैतिज तल, जिसका स्थैतिक घर्षण गुणांक 0.2 तथा गतिक घर्षण गुणांक 0.15 है, पर स्थिर अवस्था में है। यदि ब्लॉक पर एक क्षैतिज बल F = 1 N आरोपित किया जाए तो घर्षण बल का मान कितना होगा?

visuals.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 200 100'><rect x='80' y='30' width='40' height='30' fill='#f0f0f0' stroke='black'/><text x='100' y='50' text-anchor='middle' font-size='12'>1kg</text><line x1='120' y1='45' x2='150' y2='45' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><polygon points='150,40 150,50 155,45' fill='black'/><text x='138' y='38' text-anchor='middle' font-size='12'>F</text><line x1='40' y1='60' x2='160' y2='60' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><line x1='50' y1='60' x2='40' y2='70' stroke='black'/><line x1='60' y1='60' x2='50' y2='70' stroke='black'/><line x1='70' y1='60' x2='60' y2='70' stroke='black'/><line x1='80' y1='60' x2='70' y2='70' stroke='black'/><line x1='90' y1='60' x2='80' y2='70' stroke='black'/><line x1='100' y1='60' x2='90' y2='70' stroke='black'/><line x1='110' y1='60' x2='100' y2='70' stroke='black'/><line x1='120' y1='60' x2='110' y2='70' stroke='black'/><line x1='130' y1='60' x2='120' y2='70' stroke='black'/><line x1='140' y1='60' x2='130' y2='70' stroke='black'/><line x1='150' y1='60' x2='140' y2='70' stroke='black'/><line x1='90' y1='60' x2='85' y2='75' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><polygon points='82,73 88,73 85,80' fill='black'/><text x='85' y='88' text-anchor='middle' font-size='12'>f</text></svg>
visuals.description: Block of mass 1kg on rough surface with applied horizontal force F and friction f.

answer.method: Compare applied force with maximum static friction. Since F < f_s(max), friction equals applied force.

explanation.english: Maximum static friction \(f_{s(max)} = \mu_s mg = 0.2 \times 1 \times 9.8 = 1.96\text{ N}\) (or \(0.2 \times 1 \times 10 = 2\text{ N}\)). Since the applied force \(F = 1\text{ N}\) is less than the maximum static friction, the block remains at rest. By static equilibrium, the frictional force equals the applied force, which is 1 N.
explanation.hindi: अधिकतम स्थैतिक घर्षण \(f_{s(max)} = \mu_s mg = 0.2 \times 1 \times 9.8 = 1.96\text{ N}\) (या \(0.2 \times 1 \times 10 = 2\text{ N}\))। चूंकि आरोपित बल \(F = 1\text{ N}\), अधिकतम स्थैतिक घर्षण से कम है, अतः ब्लॉक स्थिर रहता है। स्थैतिक संतुलन के कारण, घर्षण बल आरोपित बल के बराबर यानी 1 N होगा।
steps: Since F < \(f_{s(max)}\), static friction adjusts to equal F.

explanation.english: Since F = 1 N < f_s(max), static friction adjusts to balance applied force, so f = 1 N.
explanation.hindi: चूंकि F = 1 N < f_s(max), स्थैतिक घर्षण आरोपित बल को संतुलित करता है, अतः f = 1 N।

explanation.english: 1.96 N is the maximum static friction, not the actual static friction for F = 1 N.
explanation.hindi: 1.96 N अधिकतम स्थैतिक घर्षण है, F = 1 N के लिए वास्तविक स्थैतिक घर्षण नहीं।

explanation.english: Incorrect calculation using g = 10 without considering applied force condition.
explanation.hindi: आरोपित बल की स्थिति पर विचार किए बिना g = 10 का उपयोग करके गलत गणना।

explanation.english: Friction is not zero when a horizontal force is applied and the block is at rest.
explanation.hindi: जब क्षैतिज बल लगाया जाता है और ब्लॉक स्थिर रहता है तो घर्षण शून्य नहीं होता।

question_text.english: Moment of Inertia of a thin uniform rod rotating about the perpendicular axis passing through its centre is I. If the same rod is bent into a ring and its moment of inertia about its diameter is I', then the ratio I/I' is -
question_text.hindi: अपने केंद्र से गुजरने वाले लंबवत अक्ष के परितः घूर्णन करती एक पतली एकसमान छड़ का जड़त्व आघूर्ण I है। यदि उसी छड़ को एक वलय के रूप में मोड़ा जाता है और इसके व्यास के परितः जड़त्व आघूर्ण I' है, तो अनुपात I/I' है -

answer.method: Express I and I' in terms of mass M and length L, then find the ratio.

explanation.english: For a thin rod of mass M and length L, moment of inertia about perpendicular axis through center is \(I = \frac{1}{12} M L^2\). When the rod is bent into a ring of radius R, the circumference is \(2\pi R = L \implies R = \frac{L}{2\pi}\). Moment of inertia of the ring about its diameter is \(I' = \frac{1}{2} M R^2 = \frac{1}{2} M \left(\frac{L}{2\pi}\right)^2 = \frac{M L^2}{8\pi^2}\). Now, the ratio \(\frac{I}{I'} = \frac{\frac{1}{12} M L^2}{\frac{1}{8\pi^2} M L^2} = \frac{8\pi^2}{12} = \frac{2}{3} \pi^2\)? Wait, let's re-verify \(\frac{8}{12} = \frac{2}{3}\). Let's check option 1: \(\frac{8}{3} \pi^2\). Let's recalculate: \(I = \frac{1}{12} M L^2\), \(I' = \frac{1}{2} M R^2 = \frac{1}{2} M (L/2\pi)^2 = \frac{M L^2}{8\pi^2}\). Thus \(I/I' = \frac{8\pi^2}{12} = \frac{2}{3}\pi^2\). Wait, let's check Option 2: \(\frac{2}{3}\pi^2\). Let's check Option 1: \(\frac{8}{3}\pi^2\). Wait, let's re-read carefully: is it \(I/I'\) or \(I'/I\)? The question says \(I/I'\). Let's check \(I/I' = \frac{1/12}{1/(8\pi^2)} = \frac{8\pi^2}{12} = \frac{2}{3}\pi^2\). Wait, let's look at option 2: \((2/3)\pi^2\). Let's re-check the options in the image: (1) \((8/3)\pi^2\), (2) \((2/3)\pi^2\), (3) \((5/3)\pi^2\), (4) \((3/2)\pi^2\). Hence option (2) is \((2/3)\pi^2\).
explanation.hindi: द्रव्यमान M और लंबाई L की पतली छड़ के लिए, केंद्र से गुजरने वाले लंबवत अक्ष के परितः जड़त्व आघूर्ण \(I = \frac{1}{12} M L^2\) है। जब छड़ को R त्रिज्या के वलय में मोड़ा जाता है, तो परिधि \(2\pi R = L \implies R = \frac{L}{2\pi}\)। वलय का व्यास के परितः जड़त्व आघूर्ण \(I' = \frac{1}{2} M R^2 = \frac{M L^2}{8\pi^2}\)। अनुपात \(\frac{I}{I'} = \frac{\frac{1}{12}}{\frac{1}{8\pi^2}} = \frac{8\pi^2}{12} = \frac{2}{3}\pi^2\)। अतः सही विकल्प (2) है।

question_text.english: During which phase of the sigmoid growth curve is the Relative Growth Rate (RGR) at its maximum?
question_text.hindi: सिग्माइड वृद्धि चक्र के किस चरण के दौरान सापेक्ष वृद्धि दर (RGR) अधिकतम होती है?

answer.method: Standard plant physiology concept regarding growth rates.

explanation.english: Relative growth rate (RGR) is the growth of a given system per unit time expressed in terms of initial size. It is maximum during the lag phase (or early phase of exponential growth when initial size is very small, but standard textbook convention in NCERT states: 'Quantitative comparisons between the ability of plants to produce new plant material can be done in two ways... Relative growth rate is maximum at the beginning / lag phase').
explanation.hindi: सापेक्ष वृद्धि दर (RGR) प्रारंभिक आकार के संदर्भ में प्रति इकाई समय में दिए गए सिस्टम की वृद्धि है। यह लैग प्रावस्था (lag phase) के दौरान अधिकतम होती है।
steps: Recall definition and behavior of Relative Growth Rate (RGR) during growth phases.
Identify that RGR is highest at the start/lag phase.

explanation.english: Absolute growth rate is high in log phase, but RGR is highest in lag phase.
explanation.hindi: लॉग प्रावस्था में निरपेक्ष वृद्धि दर उच्च होती है, लेकिन RGR लैग प्रावस्था में उच्चतम होता है।

explanation.english: Growth stops or becomes zero in stationary phase.
explanation.hindi: स्टेशनरी प्रावस्था में वृद्धि रुक जाती है या शून्य हो जाती है।

explanation.english: Growth rate decreases in deceleration phase.
explanation.hindi: डिसेलेरेशन प्रावस्था में वृद्धि दर घट जाती है।

explanation.english: Relative growth rate is maximum at the lag phase.
explanation.hindi: लैग प्रावस्था में सापेक्ष वृद्धि दर अधिकतम होती है।
